counterPolicy: Provider-reported counters only. Missing values are unavailable, never zero. Known partial totals and coverage are explicit. Completed-turn usage excludes failed calls recorded separately and excludes unavailable earlier calls in unfinished turns.

directToolCapability.method: Direct complete source reads; no model or gold hints in replay; not a ranking/agent-quality test
directToolCapability.timing: Run after all model comparisons; not used to warm sources during replay
directToolCapability.interpretation: Complete stored extracted text was returned in all eight library roles. All five assessment profiles delivered the decisive source-1 later-date clause. This does not prove original-format fidelity, ranking recall or broad agent reliability.
directToolCapability.budgetCounterMeaning: requiredTokens and returnedTokens are cl100k_base estimates for evidence JSON, including structure/provenance overhead; not provider-reported model input tokens. maxTokens is the requested read allowance.

representation.interpretation: Repeated per-section locations, headings and citations add custom full-read overhead. Complete and controlled Microsoft full reads both reconstruct two sections despite different search chunking; full-read success is not chunk-retrieval parity.

measured: provider-reported input, output, cached-input, cache-write and reasoning tokens when present
client-observed latency and reported quota waits
known retrieval request charge with completeness flags
estimated: pending reasoning context carryover used by the local guard
unavailable: total retrieval RU when any call lacks a charge
allocated worker/workflow hosting cost and workflow billed actions
measurementTaxonomy.scope: Replay usage excludes preflight/smoke calls, direct capability checks (reported separately), and unreported failed-call usage; it is not a complete Azure invoice.

reviewRubric.taskSuccess: Core requested answer delivered; ancillary attribution/quote defects can still fail other checks.
reviewRubric.sourceSupport: Substantive factual claims entailed by original evidence actually delivered; scoped qualifications are respected.
reviewRubric.citationReview: Claims/quotations attributed to the correct supplied file/location; unsupported added recommendations and meaningful unmarked quotation changes can fail.
reviewRubric.decisiveEvidenceDelivered: Task-specific original evidence reached the model; any body text is insufficient. Lost empty-cell geometry is not verified by generated descriptions.
reviewRubric.fullyClean: All three taskSuccess, sourceSupport and citationReview are true; not a general model-accuracy estimate.
reviewRubric.refusals: A pure safe refusal fails taskSuccess and has null sourceSupport/citationReview; applicable denominators exclude nulls.

limitations: Four public DOCX files, three narrow questions, two repeats; assistant judgments, not a representative benchmark or blinded human assessment.
Only the two Microsoft configurations received the matched 100k/200k answering-model follow-up; adequate-context model runs for current/custom are not established by this record.
The largest provider-reported input was 81,769 tokens. A 200k allowance was not 200k actual input; these files do not test genuinely large 200k/500k document loads. No 500k run was performed.
Provider cache state, actual inference region and request scheduling were uncontrolled; equal medium reasoning labels and token/minute caps are not equal compute.
No ingestion strategy/provider, latency or cost winner is established. Full stored extracted text does not imply original-document layout/visual completeness.
Larger context removed budget refusals in these matched tasks; it did not eliminate every malformed selector/tool error or mini citation defect.
Normal demo remains mini on Chat Completions; the larger-context Responses results were not repeated at its original 50k tokens/minute deployment cap.

A 100k shared conversation allowance cannot fit the custom two-file 92.9k estimated evidence JSON plus the existing prompt and answer reserve; choose adequate shared capacity or test response compaction separately, without changing it mid-comparison.

cleanup.verificationScope: Original deployment names, model/version, SKU/capacity and auto-upgrade settings matched the pre-experiment receipt.
